comment: I LOVED professor farizo and her class! Her teaching style was very straightforward and she provided notes packets with example problems for class lectures. You get extra credit if you do the homework and there are homeworks and quizzes each week. The exams are based off of a lot of points and she gives a good amount of review for too

Professor Farizo is a great teacher and she makes it so easy to do well in her class, even if accounting isn't your strong suit. She is such a nice person in general and truly loves it when her students succeed. She gives great and clear lectures with so many extra credit opportunities. Take her for accounting you won't regret it!

Great teacher, very knowledgeable, and explains difficult concepts clearly. The course itself is hard if you have never taken accounting, but Farizo understands that and makes it a priority for students to succeed and do well. 

Tests are weighted heavily, and it's easy to lose points.

Up to 2% points in Extra Credit throughout the course.

Class is bbq chicken. Fed content using the silverest of spoons in the clearest of notes. Just pay attention, don't fall behind, and use some critical thinking. 

Professor Farizo is also incredibly nice and helpful.
Very Type A professor. Could have been more understanding. But I understood something tho.

Mrs. Farizo is awesome! Her class is well structured, everything is organized on Blackboard. There are packets for class that also have summaries of the most important info of the chapter and vocab in the back. She is a fast grader. Her lectures follow the packets she gives you, and she is engaging, enthusiastic, and truly wants you to learn.

She is a good teacher. aside from academics tho she has absolutely no regard and is not accommodating if you have any health or personal concerns that might be affecting your class performance or attendance or ability to do quizzes or tests.

Professor Farizo is THE BEST! ACCT201 isn't an easy class but she definitely made it the easiest it possibly could be. If you need extra help do not be afraid to go to office hours. She genuinely wants to help you succeed and will explain over and over again until you understand it. If you do her review packets the test will be very much doable.

Professor Farizo is actually amazing and has a very clear and structured class. It is easy to ask for help whenever you need it, and she is always willing to meet! She tells you how everything is weighted and gives SO MANY extra credit opportunities that help boost your grade a lot! I sincerely recommend everyone to take her for 201!

Professor Farizo is definitely one of the friendliest business school professors I've had. Her detailed notes cover exactly what's on the exams, so if you pay attention in lecture and study her materials, you'll be in great shape. Understanding the content was super manageable thanks to her clear, structured teaching.
Such a great professor! Makes accounting easy and very understandable. She provides materials that will undoubtedly help you prepare for exams, and is always available to help or answer questions.

Farizo is the goat. Teaches the class w/ packets so super easy to follow. Hands out review packets that are identical to tests and plenty of extra credit work to boost your grade. Super nice person and clearly cares about you. If you're going to take ACC201, take Farizo. Just do the HW and do the quizzes with a friend and you'll get AT LEAST a B+

A very organized and structured class. 2 test, 1 final, quiz every week. I actually understood Accounting. I just do not get why sometimes why she is very not understanding and why she finds that it is such a revelation that sometimes students have things they are going through that prevents them from doing what needs to be done for the class.

Farizo is a great professor. Her lectures/notes make learning accounting, a difficult subject very easy. Test make up 75% of your grade while quizzes and in-class team assignments make up the rest. There is a weekly at home quiz and HW (which is extra credit but you really should do). Expect 1.5-2 hours of work per week on HW/Quizzes for an A.

Prof. Farizo is a great teacher who always makes an effort to get students engaged. Her teaching style is very helpful for learning the material and she hosts very helpful review sessions as well. The tests aren't anything crazy and she always wants students to do their best, so expect the test to be very similar to review material.

Do not care about your mental or physical health as long as you take her exams on time and submit all the homework on time. She does not submit the annotated slides on blackboard for some reason. Accounting is already the worst class I had taken so far; she just made it a bit more worse.

Prof Farizo is a great professor. She is knowledgable and helpful inside and outside the classroom. There is extra credit make sure you do it. She has experience as an actual accountant and really knows her stuff. I loved this class and would definitely take again. Homework is extra credit but need to do it to do well in the class.

Prof. Farizo is a incredibly knowledgeable professor. Her work in the tax profession allow her to share personal stories that make the oft-mundane tax laws come to life. She incorporates homework, exams, and 2 tax-preparation assignments with clear grading expectations throughout. Super helpful in office hours & a nice person who is eager to help.
